procedural_matters: ITA 228321 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The written protest did not identify the protestee.
conclusions: The protest did not identify the protestee, as required by RRS 60.3(a). Therefore, the protest is invalid under RRS 60.4(a)(1).
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
